title: Different Models, Shared Failures: Auditing Frozen-Encoder Pools for Medical Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41790v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Average segmentation accuracy and model count do not reveal whether models fail on the same cases. We present CoFailMed, an audit of correlated failures in pretrained-encoder pools for medical segmentation. Across five 2D tasks, we evaluate 11 public pretrained encoders (a controlled sample, not a census) using frozen features and separately trained $1\times 1$ readouts with four seeds per encoder. Shared-checkpoint pairs have the highest mean per-case Dice correlation. An expanded 17-encoder analysis shows that distinct checkpoints within the same encoder family remain more correlated than cross-family pairs. At the pooled 33rd-percentile Dice threshold, four-member pools drawn from distinct encoders have mean effective sizes of 1.56-2.92, estimated from failure correlations in pools with enough failures and passes per member. translated_title: 不同的模型，共同的失败：对医学分割中冻结编码器池的相关性失败审计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.41790v1，发布类型：交叉。平均分割精度和模型数量无法揭示不同模型是否在相同的病例上失败。我们提出了 CoFailMed，一个针对医学分割中预训练编码器池相关失败现象的审计方法。在五个二维任务上，我们使用冻结特征以及单独训练的 1×1 读出层评估了 11 个公开的预训练编码器（这是一个受控样本，而非全面普查），每个编码器使用四个随机种子。结果显示，共享检查点的编码器对具有最高的平均逐病例 Dice 相关性。扩展到 17 个编码器的分析进一步表明，同一编码器家族内不同检查点之间的失败相关性仍然高于跨家族的编码器对。在合并的 33 百分位数 Dice 阈值下，由不同编码器组成的四成员模型池的平均有效规模仅为 1.56–2.92，该数值是基于每个成员拥有足够失败与成功病例的池中的失败相关性估计得出的。在主模型池中，更丰富的读出层和微调会缩小共享同一（预训练来源的）编码器对之间的 Dice 相关性差距……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 CoFailMed 审计方法，发现医学分割中名义上不同的预训练编码器模型在同一病例上存在高度相关的失败——同家族编码器尤为严重，导致四成员模型池的平均有效规模仅约 1.56–2.92，远低于表面上的模型数量。
en_tdlr: CoFailMed audits correlated failures in frozen pretrained-encoder pools for medical segmentation, showing that nominally different models—especially within the same encoder family—fail on highly overlapping cases, so four-member pools achieve mean effective sizes of only 1.56–2.92.
